name: email
title: Email
description: Transactional email through Cloudflare Email Service, as an Effect Email service over the send_email binding. With auth, adds password reset, email verification and sign-in by code.

EMAIL_FROM.description: Sender address on a domain onboarded to Cloudflare Email Service, e.g. hello@example.com

setup.description: Onboard the sending domain with `wrangler email sending enable <domain>`, then set EMAIL_FROM to an address on it. On the Workers Free plan mail reaches only verified destination addresses; any recipient needs Workers Paid.
